在通讯促销之后
利物浦用更强烈的斗志作出回应，他们本可以在中场休息前得分，麦卡利斯特在第43分钟错失良机——接米洛斯·凯尔克兹传中头球顶高。片刻之前，维尔茨主罚左侧任意球击中横梁。
阿森纳在反击中闪光。上半场有好几次他们大举压上并创造了机会。这远非一场偷鸡摸狗的胜利。哈弗茨险些触及吉马良斯的传射，而廷贝尔在马杜埃凯从小角度将克里斯托斯·齐奥利斯的传中凌空垫回门前后也未能及时反应。
阿森纳将比赛掌控在他们想要的位置。他们坚信自己能够挡住利物浦。这关乎他们的比赛管理。他们已经成为消磨比赛大师，下半场时间越久，阿森纳看起来就越自信。他们压制了利物浦，并且始终让人觉得他们能在反击中给予致命一击。
当雅凯在第68分钟滑倒时，阿森纳将球打到左路寻找齐奥利斯，后者险些助攻厄德高。在阿利森失位的情况下，雅凯回追作出了关键解围。齐奥利斯还通过一脚远角劲射迫使门将做出精彩扑救。利物浦为控制情绪进行着一场注定失利的战斗。他们气喘吁吁。扳平比分的进球从未出现。

items.summaryEn: Kai Havertz grabs the only goal of the game to record our first win at Anfield in 14 years to beat the Reds in the Premier League
bodyEn: We recorded our first win at Anfield for 14 years thanks to Kai Havertz’s first-half goal.

The German stole in at the far post to convert Declan Rice’s low cross, and it was the only goal of the game, as we dug in to repel everything the hosts had to throw at us after that. The first half saw plenty of goalmouth action, but Havertz was the only one to find the net.
The rest of the half was mainly about repelling the threat of Liverpool, though we also came close to extending our lead through Bruno and Noni Madueke.

We continued to work hard in the second half, preventing Liverpool from having a single shot on target, to see out a fantastic win at Anfield - our first since 2012 - and go back to the top of the league.

The game began at a blistering pace, with Liverpool pressing us high whenever we were in possession. The returning Christos Tzolis, playing his first game for a month, threatened to get in behind the Liverpool back line on the counter-attack twice in the opening 10 minutes, though. The first time his low cross was cut out and the second he ran out of ground before he could send the ball into the box.
Rice then shot well over from 25 yards before we went ahead.

Alisson’s rushed clearance was cut out by Martin Odegaard and the ball was quickly recycled to the advancing Rice on the right. His low cross was perfectly placed, through the corridor of uncertainty, and gleefully tapped home at the far post by Havertz. The goal made him the all-time leading German goalscorer in Premier League history.

Liverpool responded well to falling behind and started to put us under pressure. Alexander Isak had a glorious chance in front of goal but couldn’t get his head to an inswinging cross before Bruno came to the rescue to stop a Barcola run at the near post.
At the other end, Bruno dragged a shot just wide after Tzolis led another counter-attack, before Madueke was denied by Alisson at the far post from a deep Tzolis cross.

Liverpool were the more dangerous team though, and we had to stand firm as they had their tails up and won a succession of corners. Virgil van Dijk came close when his header was dangerous, but David Raya got enough on it low down to turn it away.

Florian Wirtz was next to go close. His free kick from a narrow angle beat everyone, and looked to be looping in, but thumped off the crossbar and away. The crosses continued to rain in. Alexis Mac Allister arrived in front of goal to meet a left wing ball, but planted his header over the bar.

Liverpool were enjoying much more of the possession, and much of the game was being played in and around our own penalty box, but Konsa and Gabriel stood firm as we got to half-time with a narrow lead.

Liverpool came out strongly at the start of the second half too, and we had to remain compact and organised. We retained a threat on the break, and Tzolis capitalised on a slip to burst into the box, and his cross was heading for Odegaard before a well-timed intervention.

Riccardo Calafiori then saw his low cross cleared on the line as we began to come back into the game again. Tzolis then forced an excellent lo diving save from Alisson when his first time right-footed shot seemed destined for the bottom corner.

But make no mistake, we were also having to work hard at the back. Jurrien Timber was the next to make a crucial block in his own box. All the work paid off, as we saw out the win to return to the top of the table – our 300th Premier League away victory.
FACTS AND STATS

We achieved our first victory in any competition at Anfield since September 2012, ending a run of 16 trips without a win there. This was also our first clean sheet there in the Premier League since that victory in 2012.

Our 24 points this term is the most by a team after nine games of a Premier League season since the Gunners themselves in 2022/23 (also 24). Only in 2004/05 and 2007/08 have they ever had more at this stage of a Premier League campaign (25 in both).

For the first time on record (since 2003/04), Liverpool failed to record a shot on target in a Premier League game at Anfield. Today was their 442nd league match played at the venue since the start of the 2003/04 campaign.
Liverpool have scored just four goals at Anfield in the Premier League this season, their joint-fewest after five home matches in a top-flight campaign (also four in 1913/14 and 2012/13).

Under Mikel Arteta, we have gone on to win 81.1% of the Premier League matches in which we have opened the scoring (137/169). Of managers to see their side open the scoring 100+ times in the competition, only Alex Ferguson (87.4%), Pep Guardiola (84.5%), and José Mourinho (83.0%) have higher win percentages when doing so.
Kai Havertz’s opener saw him become the top-scoring German player in Premier League history (46 goals), overtaking Ilkay Gundoğan (45).

Both of Havertz’s Premier League goals against Liverpool have put his side 1-0 ahead at Anfield (for Chelsea in August 2021 and Arsenal today). He’s the third visiting player to score an opener at Anfield for two different clubs in the competition, following Brian Deane (Leeds/Sheffield United) and Darren Anderton (Tottenham/Birmingham).
WHAT’S NEXT

We head back into Europe in midweek, to play Slavia Prague away on Wednesday evening on Matchday Four in the Champions League. Our next Premier League game is at home to Hull City next Saturday before the November international break.

items.titleZh: 战报：利物浦 0-1 阿森纳
items.summaryZh: 哈弗茨攻入全场唯一进球，助阿森纳客场击败利物浦，时隔14年再度在安菲尔德取胜。
bodyZh: 凭借哈弗茨在上半场的进球，我们时隔14年再次在安菲尔德球场取胜。
这位德国球员在远门柱包抄，接到德克兰·赖斯的低平球传中破门，这也是全场唯一的进球。此后我们全线防守，顶住了主队发起的一切进攻。上半场创造了不少门前机会，但只有哈弗茨破门得分。
上半场的剩余时间主要是在抵御利物浦的威胁，不过我们也通过布鲁诺和诺尼·马杜埃凯险些扩大领先优势。
我们在下半场继续努力防守，没有让利物浦有任何一次射门命中门框范围内，最终在安菲尔德取得了一场梦幻般的胜利——这是我们自2012年以来的首次客场击败对手——并重返英超积分榜榜首。
比赛以极快的节奏开始，只要我们控球，利物浦就会进行高位逼抢。不过，重回首发的赫里斯托斯·齐奥利斯在开场10分钟内两次通过反击威胁利物浦防线，这是他一个月以来的首场比赛。第一次他的低平球传中被解围，第二次他在将球传进禁区前跑出了底线。
随后赖斯在25码外远射高出横梁，之后我们就取得了领先。
阿利森仓促的解围被马丁·厄德高截获，皮球迅速传给了插上的赖斯。他的低平球传中恰到好处，穿过了防守盲区，哈弗茨在远门柱轻松推射破门。这粒进球使他成为英超历史上进球最多的德国球员。
利物浦在落后之后做出积极回应，开始给我们施加压力。亚历山大·伊萨克在门前获得绝佳机会，但未能抢到传中头球攻门，随后布鲁诺及时补防，在近门柱化解了巴尔科拉的突破。
在另一端，齐奥利斯策动又一次反击后，布鲁诺的射门稍稍偏出；随后齐奥利斯送出精准传中，马杜埃凯在远门柱的射门被阿利森化解。
不过利物浦是更危险的一方，随着他们气势高涨并连续获得角球，我们不得不坚守阵地。范戴克的头球极具威胁，但大卫·雷亚低身将球扑出。
弗洛里安·维尔茨险些破门。他的小角度任意球绕过所有人，眼看就要钻入网窝，却狠狠击中横梁弹出。主队的传中雨雪纷飞般袭来。亚历西斯·麦卡利斯特在门前接左路传球头球攻门，但将球顶高。
利物浦控球率明显占优，大部分比赛都在我们的禁区内及周围展开，但孔萨和加布里埃尔坚守防线，让我们带着一球的微弱优势进入中场休息。
下半场开始后利物浦攻势依旧强劲，我们必须保持阵型紧凑有序。我们在反击中依然极具威胁，齐奥利斯利用对方失误突入禁区，他的传中眼看就要连线厄德高，但对方及时将球破坏。
随后里卡多·卡拉菲奥里的低平球传中在门线上被解围，我们的进攻逐渐有所起色。齐奥利斯随后的一脚右脚抢射直奔球门死角，迫使阿利森作出了一次精彩的倒地扑救。
但毫无疑问，我们的后防线也承受了巨大压力。尤里恩·廷贝尔随后在自家禁区内完成了一次关键封堵。所有的努力得到了回报，我们守住了胜果，重返积分榜榜首——这也是我们在英超联赛中的第300场客场胜利。
事实与数据
我们取得了自2012年9月以来各项赛事在安菲尔德的第一场胜利，打破了此前在此客场16场不胜的纪录。这也是我们自2012年那场胜利以来，首次在英超客场对阵利物浦时保持零封。
我们本赛季前9场比赛拿到24分，这是英超联赛自2022/23赛季的枪手自身（同样是24分）以来，球队在开局前9场比赛中获得的最高积分。在英超历史上，只有在2004/05赛季和2007/08赛季的同一阶段积分更多（均为25分）。
有记录以来（自2003/04赛季起）首次，利物浦在英超安菲尔德球场的比赛中没有完成一次射门命中门框范围。今天是他们自2003/04赛季开始以来在此进行的第442场联赛。
利物浦本赛季在英超安菲尔德球场仅打入4球，追平了他们在顶级联赛主场前5场比赛后的最少进球纪录（1913/14赛季和2012/13赛季也为4球）。
在米克尔·阿尔特塔的带领下，我们在英超率先破门的比赛中赢下了81.1%的胜利（169场中137场获胜）。在联赛中率队率先破门超过100次的教练中，只有亚历克斯·弗格森（87.4%）、佩普·瓜迪奥拉（84.5%）和何塞·穆里尼奥（83.0%）的胜率高于此。
哈弗茨的进球使他超越京多安（45球），以46个进球成为英超历史进球最多的德国球员。
哈弗茨在英超对阵利物浦的两粒进球，都帮助他的球队在安菲尔德取得1-0领先（2021年8月代表切尔西以及今天代表阿森纳）。他成为继布莱恩·迪恩（利兹联/谢菲尔德联）和达伦·安德顿（托特纳姆热刺/伯明翰）之后，第三位在英超代表两支不同客队在安菲尔德率先破门的球员。
接下来的赛程
周中我们将重返欧洲赛场，于周三晚上在欧冠联赛阶段第四轮客场对阵布拉格斯拉维亚。我们的下一场英超比赛将于下周六在主场对阵赫尔城，随后迎来11月的国际比赛日。

items.titleEn: If Mikel Arteta’s dossier is part of a deliberate strategy, it is a dangerous one for Arsenal | Jonathan Wilson
items.summaryEn: The manager is not yet in Alex Ferguson and José Mourinho’s league, but his conspiracy theories have reached new levelsEnglish football loves the word “dossier”. bodyEn: English football loves the word “dossier”. It doesn’t love dossiers themselves, of course; they’re for nerds – unless, that is, they’re a “secret dossier”, which have a thrilling redolence of spy dramas, invisible ink and dead drops. Non-secret dossiers, though, are inherently risible: call something a “dossier” in English football and you’re immediately signalling: this is absurd poindextering. Dossiers were preposterous when Don Revie was – imagine the pretension! – drawing up scouting reports on opposing players, and they are preposterous today as Mikel Arteta collates images of rival managers stepping outside their technical area.

Arteta, it should be said, did not use the word “dossier”; rather it was swiftly applied to what he had called “a massive storage of images”. During Arsenal’s 2-0 win against Everton last Saturday, he received his second booking of the season for leaving his technical area. This, it turns out, is another part of the vast conspiracy against Arsenal. Yes, Arteta accepted, he left his technical area (44 times before being booked, according to the former referee Graham Scott), but other managers do it too. “There are managers who have the record in the league, 36 times in 10 minutes [they] leave the touchline – no yellows,” he said. “I am clipping all of that … so if somebody comes to me I can say: ‘I am not in the record yet.’ Somebody else has the record so let’s see. Then it’s 36 yellow cards in 10 minutes for the managers.”

There are two ways of looking at this. Perhaps it’s genuine. Perhaps Arteta really is a ludicrous Pooterish figure, counting the misdemeanours of others, the worst kind of neighbourhood watch curtain-twitcher who happens also to have been cursed with a persecution complex: “I got a fine because my parking permit was partially obscured, but Mr Emery at No 17 has been six inches out of his bay on at least three occasions this month and … nothing.” Or perhaps he really is an inveterate snitch, glorying in telling on his peers: “Please, Miss! Miss, Daniel’s been chewing gum again, Miss.”

Or, perhaps awed by the misguided defiance of Manchester City fans after their club was found to have perpetrated the greatest act of cheating in English sporting history, he is trying to persuade his base that everybody is against Arsenal to generate a siege mentality. Declan Rice mystifyingly got away with kicking Malick Yalcouyé off the ball against Brighton, but it’s important to remember that Arsenal remain the real victims here.

The history of mind games in football is long and storied. Before the 1939 FA Cup final, for instance, Major Frank Buckley, the flamboyant manager of Wolves, claimed to have injected his players with “animal secretions”. A French surgeon, Serge Voronoff, had begun transplanting tissue from monkey testicles on to human testicles as an anti-ageing treatment, and it was widely believed that it was this monkey gland treatment that Buckley was employing. In fact, he almost certainly gave his players nothing stronger than vitamins but the idea was that Wolves’ morale would be boosted, while their opponents in the final, Portsmouth, would be intimidated by the prospect of taking on players juiced up on simian fluids. It didn’t work, Portsmouth winning 4-1 despite finishing 15 places below Wolves in the table, but the logic is familiar.

The monkey glands were relatively benign, little more than a publicity stunt, but it’s easy for attempts at psychological manipulation to take on a darker aspect. Before Inter played Liverpool in the second leg of the 1965 European Cup semi-final, for instance, their manager, Helenio Herrera, had 100,000 leaflets distributed claiming that at the end of the first leg at Anfield, Liverpool fans had sung “Go home, Italians” to the tune of “Santa Lucia” which supposedly was intended “to deride us and make us feel we are just a race of cheap mandolin players”. Suitably enraged, Inter fans ensured San Siro seethed with fury, which perhaps encouraged some questionable refereeing decisions (although it probably wasn’t the only factor) as Liverpool lost 3-0 and went out 4-3 on aggregate.

Alex Ferguson was a master of the art, while José Mourinho openly acknowledged that the next game begins in the post-match press conference for the previous one. Mourinho, in particular, often crossed the line of professional decency. Arteta, clearly, is not at that level, at least not yet, but if his dossier is part of a deliberate strategy it is a dangerous one.

Arteta’s conspiracy theory is likely to find fertile ground among certain online Arsenal fans, who remain convinced that referees have been machinating against them for years. Even on Tuesday there were those who leaped to the defence of Max Dowman after he had been sent off for thrusting a knee towards Harrison Neal’s chest, even though Arteta himself appeared furious with the 16-year-old’s petulance. Why, ran the argument, had Cole Palmer not been shown a straight red for retaliating against Mateus Fernandes in Chelsea’s defeat by Tottenham on Saturday? Dowman went with his knee and Palmer with his belly, which is perhaps enough to explain the discrepancy, but even if it isn’t, so what? If you don’t want to be punished, don’t go thrusting knees or bellies or anything at opponents, no matter how bad a foul they’ve just committed.

It’s not only that football is groaning under the weight of the paranoia of various fan groups, each adamant that Pro Ref is acting with the rosicrucians, the Masons, the mob, Opus Dei and the Cubans to deny their club a spot in the Europa League, a distraction that deflects from the game’s true crisis: its descent from an endeavour in which sporting merit and integrity are paramount into a grimly capitalistic vehicle to make very rich and powerful people even richer and more powerful.

It’s also dangerous because a mood of insecurity, of being convinced everything is against you, is not conducive to winning league titles – as Arsenal know. In 2024-25, their title bid was undermined by their early-season ill discipline, each red card greeted not with the resilience of champions but with bleating about how it wasn’t really their fault and everybody was picking on them, including the injury gods.
Abdicating responsibility rarely helps, snitches seldom prosper and, in English football, dossiers are always a bad idea.

items.titleZh: 若米克尔·阿尔特塔的资料集是一项刻意策略，这对阿森纳来说极其危险 | 乔纳森·威尔逊
items.summaryZh: 阿尔特塔收集对手教练越界的画面引发争议，若此阴谋论是刻意策略，对阿森纳而言将十分危险。
bodyZh: 英格兰足球界喜欢用“资料集（dossier）”这个词。当然，人们并不真正喜欢资料集本身，那是书呆子的玩意——除非它是“秘密资料集”，带有一种间谍剧、隐形墨水和死信箱的刺激氛围。然而，非秘密资料集的本质是可笑的：在英格兰足球中，把某样东西称为“资料集”就是在明确释放信号：这是荒谬的学究气。当唐·里维（Don Revie）——想象一下那种假惺惺的做作——为对手球员制作球探报告时，资料集就显得荒谬，而今天米克尔·阿尔特塔（Mikel Arteta）收集对手教练跨出技术区域的影像时，同样荒谬。

需要指出的是，阿尔特塔本人并没有使用“资料集”这个词；这个词很快就被贴在了他所说的“海量影像存储”上。在上周六阿森纳2-0战胜埃弗顿的比赛中，他因离开技术区域而收到了本赛季的第二张黄牌。事实证明，这是针对阿森纳庞大阴谋的又一部分。是的，阿尔特塔承认他离开了技术区域（据前裁判格雷厄姆·斯科特统计，在被黄牌警告前有44次），但其他教练也这么做。“有些教练在联赛中保持着记录，10分钟内36次离开教练指挥区——却没有黄牌，”他说。“我把所有这些都剪辑下来……所以如果有人来找我说事，我可以回答：‘我的纪录还没到呢。’别人保持着纪录，让我们拭目以待。那么接下来就是10分钟内给教练出示36张黄牌。”

看待这件事有两种方式。也许这是真情流露。也许阿尔特塔真的成了一个荒唐可笑的普特（Pooterish）式人物，数着别人的轻罪，就像那种最糟糕的社区守望相助中爱窥视窗帘的小人，偏巧又患有被害妄想症：“我因为停车证部分被遮挡而罚款，但17号的埃米利县先生这个月至少有三次把车停在车位外面六英寸……却什么事都没有。”或者他真的成了一个根深蒂固的小报告分子，以告发同行为乐：“老师！老师，丹尼又在嚼口香糖了，老师。”
或者，也许是被曼城球迷在俱乐部被发现实施了英格兰体育史上最大作弊行为后表现出的那种被误导的挑衅所震撼，他正试图向其基本盘灌输所有人都在与阿森纳作对的想法，从而营造一种围城心态。德克兰·赖斯（Declan Rice）在对阵布莱顿的比赛中无球踢倒马利克·亚尔库耶（Malick Yalcouyé）却离奇地逃脱了惩罚，但重要的是要记住，阿森纳仍然是这里真正的受害者。

足球界心理战的历史悠久且充满传奇。例如，在1939年足总杯决赛之前，狼队张扬的主帅弗兰克·巴克利（Frank Buckley）少校声称给他的球员注射了“动物分泌物”。一位法国外科医生谢尔盖·沃罗诺夫（Serge Voronoff）曾开始将猴子睾丸组织移植到人类睾丸上作为抗衰老疗法，人们普遍认为巴克利采用的就是这种猴腺疗法。事实上，他给球员使用的东西几乎不可能比维生素更强烈，但其目的是为了提升狼队的士气，同时让决赛对手朴茨茅斯因为要对付注入了类人猿体液的球员而感到畏惧。这并没有起作用，朴茨茅斯以4-1获胜，尽管他们在积分榜上比狼队低了15位，但这种逻辑却是大家熟悉的。

猴腺疗法相对温和，不过是个宣传噱头，但心理战的尝试很容易呈现出更黑暗的一面。例如，在国际米兰对阵利物浦的1965年欧洲冠军杯半决赛次回合之前，他们的主帅海伦尼奥·埃雷拉（Helenio Herrera）散发了10万份传单，声称在安菲尔德的首回合比赛结束后，利物浦球迷曾伴着《圣露西亚》的曲调高唱“回你们的意大利去吧”，这据称旨在“嘲笑我们，让我们觉得我们只是一个廉价曼陀林演奏者的民族”。在被彻底激怒后，国际米兰球迷确保了圣西罗球场怒火中烧，这或许促使裁判做出了一些值得商榷的判决（尽管这可能不是唯一的因素），最终利物浦0-3失利，总比分3-4被淘汰。
亚历克斯·弗格森（Alex Ferguson）是这门艺术的大师，而何塞·穆里尼奥（José Mourinho）则公开承认，下一场比赛是从上一场的赛后新闻发布会开始的。尤其是穆里尼奥，经常越过职业体面的底线。显然，阿尔特塔还没有达到那个水平，至少目前还没有，但如果他的资料集是一项刻意策略，那将是一个危险的策略。

阿尔特塔的阴谋论很可能会在某些在线阿森纳球迷中找到肥沃的土壤，他们仍然坚信裁判多年来一直在密谋对付他们。甚至在周二，还有人跳出来为麦克斯·唐曼（Max Dowman）辩护，此前他因用膝盖撞击哈里森·尼尔（Harrison Neal）的胸部而被罚下，尽管阿尔特塔本人似乎对这位16岁球员的暴躁脾气怒不可遏。反驳的论点是，为什么在切尔西周六输给托特纳姆热刺的比赛中，科尔·帕尔默（Cole Palmer）因对马特乌斯·费尔南德斯（Mateus Fernandes）进行报复而没有被直接红牌罚下？唐曼用的是膝盖，帕尔默用的是肚子，这或许足以解释两者的差异，但即使解释不了，那又怎样？如果你不想受到惩罚，就不要把膝盖、肚子或任何东西撞向对手，无论他们刚才犯规有多严重。
注册每日足球
用卫报对世界足球的视角开启你的夜晚
在推广简报之后
不仅是足球在各种球迷群体的偏执重压下呻吟，每个球迷群体都坚信职业裁判在与玫瑰十字会、共济会、黑帮、主业会和古巴人勾结，剥夺他们俱乐部参加欧联杯的资格，这种干扰转移了人们对足球真正危机的视线：它从一项将体育精神和正直放在首位的运动，沦为了一个严酷的资本主义工具，旨在让非常富有和强大的人变得更加富有和强大。
这也之所以危险，是因为一种不安全感、确信一切都对你不利的氛围，并不利于赢得联赛冠军——正如阿森纳所知。在2024-25赛季，他们的争冠努力由于赛季初期的纪律涣散而受到破坏，每一次红牌迎来的不是冠军的韧性，而是关于错不在他们、所有人都在找他们麻烦（包括伤病之神）的抱怨。
推卸责任很少有帮助，打小报告的人很少能飞黄腾达，而在英格兰足球中，资料集永远都是个坏主意。

items.titleEn: Disabled Supporter's Ticket Information | Ipswich Town (H)
bodyEn: Arsenal v Ipswich TownSaturday 2nd JanuaryPremier LeagueEmirates StadiumKick Off: 15.00
This will be a Category C fixture (pricing and information on match categorisation).
Ballot System for Disability Access Members
To ensure fairness and equal opportunity, tickets for all home fixtures will be sold via a ballot system exclusively for Arsenal Members.

Members will have a designated window to enter the ballot. You can choose to register individually or as a group of up to four members, if all supporters meet the necessary requirements. You can enter at any stage during the registration window, and your odds of success will remain the same.

Timing doesn't matter when it comes to entering our ballots, whether you are an early bird or a last-minute entrant, your chances of winning remain the same. The only crucial factor is that you submit your entry whilst the window is open.
Ballot opens: Friday 6th November at 10am
Ballot closes: Monday 9th November at 12pm
Please do not enter via your online account as this will not work for DA members.

All applicants, whether successful or unsuccessful, will be notified by email only, by 2pm on Tuesday 10th November. Successful applicants will have the opportunity to purchase tickets during the designated priority booking window, as specified on the ticket information page.

This fixture will be on sale on Wednesday 11th November at 10am and successful applicants will be able to access their online account to purchase tickets, this will include a complimentary Personal Assistant ticket, subject to eligibility. Please note, you will have until 10am on Thursday 12th November to purchase your tickets.
Where the number of ballot registrations for a match does not exceed the number of available tickets, all Members who have entered will be successful.
Useful links
Ticket Exchange & Ticket Transfer

If a Member is unable to attend a match they were successful in the ballot for, and that match has sold out, they will have the option to post their ticket on our Ticket Exchange platform. This way, other fans can purchase the ticket and enjoy the match. This ticket information page will be updated once a fixture has sold out and Ticket Exchange is available.
Ticket Transfer is available for Season Ticket Holders to use once a game is available online (4-8 weeks before a game).

Disability Access members who wish to list their tickets on the Ticket Exchange should complete the online form here. Please note this form is for DA members only and tickets will be listed by the Disability Liaison Team. The Disability Liaison Team can be contacted by calling 0207 619 5000 (Option 2). Deaf supporters, who use British Sign Language (BSL), can contact the Disability Liaison Team by using SignVideo BSL Interpreter service.

The Arsenal App This latest update to the Arsenal app means access to the Ticket Hub has changed. To continue to manage your tickets via the Ticket Hub, you must ensure you have the latest version of The Arsenal app and log in to your account using your email/username and password.
Digital TicketsAny tickets purchased by members for the 2026/2027 season, will be loaded onto their digital membership pass via the official Arsenal app.

Once the digital pass has been added to an Apple or Android wallet, any purchased tickets will automatically show on the digital pass approximately one week before the relevant fixture. Click here for more information.
Stadium Access Please note that you MUST enter the Stadium with your Personal Assistant, if eligible.
Code of Conduct All fans must adhere to our updated Code of Conduct; please take your time to read this information carefully
Accessible ParkingThe Accessible Parking booking period will open on Wednesday 18th November and will close once we have no spaces remaining. You can view the parking information here.

items.summaryZh: 阿森纳对阵伊普斯维奇的残疾球迷球票抽签系统将于11月6日开启。
bodyZh: 阿森纳对阵伊普斯维奇，1月2日星期六，英超联赛，酋长球场，开球时间：15:00
这将是一场C类比赛（关于比赛分类的价格及信息）。
残疾无障碍会员抽签系统
为确保公平和机会均等，所有主场比赛的球票将通过抽签系统独家向阿森纳会员出售。
会员将有一个指定的窗口期来参与抽签。如果所有球迷均符合必要的要求，您可以选择个人注册，或者以最多四名会员的团体形式注册。您可以在注册窗口期间的任何阶段参与，您的中签几率将保持不变。
参与我们的抽签时时间并不重要，无论您是早鸟还是最后时刻加入的参与者，您中奖的机会都是一样的。唯一至关重要的因素是您必须在窗口开放期间提交您的申请。
抽签开启时间：11月6日星期五上午10点
抽签截止时间：11月9日星期一中午12点
请不要通过您的在线账户进行申请，因为这不适用于残疾无障碍会员。
无论成功与否，所有申请者将在11月10日星期二下午2点之前仅通过电子邮件收到通知。中签的申请者将有机会在票务信息页面上指定的优先购票窗口期内购买球票。
本场比赛将于11月11日星期日上午10点开始发售，中签的申请者将能够访问他们的在线账户购买球票，这将在符合资格的前提下包含一张免费的个人助理球票。请注意，您必须在11月12日星期四上午10点之前完成球票购买。
如果某场比赛的抽签报名人数未超过可用球票数量，所有参与的会员都将中签。
实用链接
球票交流与球票转让
如果会员无法出席其在抽签中中签的比赛，且该场比赛已售罄，他们可以选择将球票发布到我们的球票交流平台上。这样，其他球迷就可以购买球票并享受比赛。一旦比赛售罄且球票交流可用，本球票信息页面将会更新。
一旦比赛在网上可用（比赛开始前4至8周），季票持有者即可使用球票转让功能。
希望在球票交流平台上挂牌球票的残疾无障碍会员应在此处填写在线表格。请注意，此表格仅适用于残疾无障碍会员，球票将由残疾人联络团队进行挂牌。可以通过拨打0207 619 5000（选择2）联系残疾人联络团队。使用英国手语（BSL）的聋哑球迷可以使用SignVideo BSL手语翻译服务联系残疾人联络团队。
阿森纳应用程序：阿森纳应用程序的最新更新意味着票务中心的访问方式发生了变化。要继续通过票务中心管理您的球票，您必须确保拥有最新版本的阿森纳应用程序，并使用您的电子邮箱/用户名和密码登录您的账户。
电子球票：会员为2026/2027赛季购买的任何球票，都将通过官方阿森纳应用程序加载到他们的电子会员证上。
一旦电子会员证被添加到Apple或Android钱包中，任何购买的球票都会在相关比赛前大约一周自动显示在电子会员证上。点击此处了解更多信息。
球场入场：请注意，如果符合条件，您必须与您的个人助理一起进入球场。
行为准则：所有球迷必须遵守我们更新的行为准则；请花时间仔细阅读此信息
无障碍停车：无障碍停车预订期将于11月18日星期三开始，并在车位售罄后关闭。您可以在此处查看停车信息。
